title: M7 Sol independent whole-Bible candidate chunking campaign
objective: Produce one candidate-only literary and structural chunk map covering every canonical verse in all 66 books, with chunk-level specialist challenge, resolution, dissent, and appeal evidence.

allowed_effects: run local read-only evidence queries and deterministic checks
record read-only subagent reviews and appeals
prohibited_effects: decide theology canon authorship reading translation or source tradition
create graph retrieval or vector truth
human_gates: unresolved reasoned appeal blocks promotion and convergence but not the next canonical book

execution.receipt_dag: B00-B09 -> precompletion manifest -> B10 -> terminal completion -> external qualification

gold_standards.statement: Every canonical verse is covered exactly once with no gap or overlap.
Every decision_id has two artifact-blind role-separated reviews, peer cross-check, Sol responses, role-separated postcheck, preserved appeals, and explicit shared-substrate disclosure.
No other-model artifact or authority-bearing output enters M7.
